key_insight: BRIDGE provides paired prostate biopsy images across three preparation stages to support research on AI-based virtual staining and related imaging methods.
clinical_relevance: The dataset could help researchers evaluate methods intended to streamline histopathology workflows, but the abstract does not establish clinical performance.
method: Sequentially scan each slide in paraffin, after deparaffinization, and after H&E staining.
Pair images across stages and provide slide-level Gleason scores.
Distribute de-identified images in native scanner format through the BioImage Archive.
evidence_signal: The dataset contains 2,607 whole-slide images from 869 slides across 169 patients at one Polish oncology centre; no model performance results are reported in the abstract.
watch_item: Single-centre sourcing may limit generalizability, so models developed using BRIDGE need independent validation across institutions and imaging workflows.
paper_title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
